title: A — Editorial welcome
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity Wedding Market website sign-in design comparison board, one design direction per image. This is a proposed website UI, not a live screenshot. Produce a crisp polished landscape image around 2000x1350, readable UI text, impeccable spacing. Use the supplied image ONLY as reference for existing brand typography/palette: uppercase light elegant serif WEDDING MARKET wordmark, light GT Super-like display serif, restrained Lucia-like script accent, Acumin-like readable sans-serif body. Do not copy the vendor profile screen. Palette warm ivory #faf8f4, champagne #e7dfd2, dark warm brown #332d27, muted brown #7b6d60. No green. No new logo, no invented verification/social proof, counts, payment or subscriptions. Restrained fine rules and squared soft 4px corner controls, not bubbly SaaS cards. Every visible form has readable persistent labels Email and Password, empty outlined 48px inputs, Show at password right, Forgot password? link, a full-width dark brown Sign in button, fine divider, outlined Continue with Google button with small standard colored G. Below form: 'New here?' then distinct links 'Create a couple account' and 'Register your business', plus tiny 'Free to join'. One shared login for couples and vendors; no mandatory role picker or role tabs. No Apple login or new authentication method. Image should present large DESKTOP view on left 72% and MOBILE phone-width web view on right 24%, device-free rounded browser canvas with slim chrome, on warm neutral board. Both views wholly visible, no obscuring overlapping phones. Small labels outside screens 'DESKTOP · SHARED SIGN IN' and 'MOBILE · SHARED SIGN IN'. Outside screens top board heading uses the option name. Bottom outside screens a concise one-line design description. Within screens top simplified existing navigation: WEDDING MARKET left; search icon and Menu right on desktop, Menu on phone. Include EN / ES language choice within auth content. All copy in English. Large photos if specified should be plausible Costa Rica wedding editorial photography and visibly conceptual imagery, not vendor listings. UI must be coherent and buildable.
OPTION NAME: 'A / EDITORIAL WELCOME'. Desktop is full-height split under existing header: left 46% large cinematic natural wedding reception photograph, ivory flowers, linen tables, tropical garden at dusk with subtle brown bottom gradient. Lower photo has delicate white serif 'A beautiful day,' and modest script 'begins here.' Right 54% uninterrupted ivory space with compact 380px form. Tiny eyebrow 'ONE ACCOUNT, EVERY POSSIBILITY'; clear serif heading 'Welcome back.'; body 'Sign in to plan your wedding or manage your business.' Fields and buttons as above with generous but compact vertical rhythm. EN / ES at top-right of form area. Mobile uses a short 105px wedding photo strip beneath header, then directly on ivory the exact clear shared sign-in form with 28px heading, small body, both signup links, no boxed card. Forms fit inside each displayed browser view. Caption outside screens: 'A warm, photo-led welcome with one clear account entrance.' Elegant publication-quality web UI.
